purpose: Test whether a persistent task-reasoning-evidence workspace reduces root-task loss and unsupported closure without reducing M0's flexible monitoring capability.

conditions.treatment: m0-v1.1 plus the independently switchable M1 workspace
conditions.only_intended_difference: M1 workspace persistence, update, retrieval, and reconstruction

frozen_runtime.paired_run_note: Provider APIs expose no reliable seed; each pair is a controlled exploratory branch comparison, not a deterministic paired sample.

tasks.historical_failure: Agent promoted import success to all twelve targets complete; native evaluation passed only 2/12 phases.
tasks.m1_question: Can persistent root-to-local relations prevent broad proxy evidence from replacing target-level obligations?

tasks.historical_failure: Natural Agent completed with 5/7 phases; M0 later produced a 7/7 run with useful sparse multi-turn correction.
tasks.m1_question: Does the workspace preserve M0's flexible test-oracle auditing, repair tracking, silence, and residual UNKNOWN release?

tasks.historical_failure: M0 resolved the native task but repeatedly widened scope and later forgot an already-corrected environment constraint.
tasks.m1_question: Can persistent intent, hypothesis, constraint, and root links reduce reconstruction loss without freezing an over-broad scope?

tasks.historical_failure: Many valid proxy observations accumulated without proving a visible controllable Windows desktop; the prior M0 run was truncated by the old outer 3600-second timeout.
tasks.m1_question: Can the workspace preserve proxy-to-root distinctions and repair history across a long environment task?
